turns.question: Of the returns of orders placed from August to October 2026, what share were returned as damaged?
turns.answer: 50% (0.5) of the returns of orders placed from 1 August to 31 October 2026 were for damaged goods, over the period 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.
